def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate the full-width and full-height separator lines.
    sep = next(v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if v != 0 and
               sum(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid) >= 1)
    # Choose the color forming both horizontal and vertical separator lines.
    sep = next(v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if v != 0 and
               any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid) and
               any(all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)))

    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]

    row_ranges = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1])
                  for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    col_ranges = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1])
                  for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]

    # Marker colors are the objects in the first region of each row band.
    marker_colors = []
    for r0, r1 in row_ranges:
        marker_colors.append(next(grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1)
                                  for c in range(col_ranges[0][0], col_ranges[0][1])
                                  if grid[r][c] != 0))

    # The patterned region uses a color distinct from the row markers.
    candidates = set(sum(grid, [])) - {0, sep} - set(marker_colors)
    pattern_color = next(iter(candidates))
    pattern = None
    for r0, r1 in row_ranges:
        for c0, c1 in col_ranges:
            cells = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1)] for r in range(r0, r1)]
            if any(pattern_color in row for row in cells):
                pattern = [[x == pattern_color for x in row] for row in cells]
                break
        if pattern is not None:
            break

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_ranges):
        color = marker_colors[i]
        for c0, c1 in col_ranges:
            for dr in range(r1 - r0):
                for dc in range(c1 - c0):
                    out[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = color if pattern[dr][dc] else 0
    return out
